---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, new pedal or DSP effect for NeurAmpli
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: tiadiff
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen (e.g., a specific new overdrive pedal, a new delay type, a new UI feature).

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Technical / Mathematical references (Optional but highly recommended)**
If your feature includes adding a new DSP filter or effect, please link to any references, papers, algorithms (e.g. Musicdsp.org snippets), or concepts that describe how to implement it correctly.

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
